name: CASIA Image Tampering Detection Evaluation Database v1/v2
description: Image-splicing forgery dataset with CASIA v1 (921 tampered images) and CASIA v2 (5,123 tampered images), used for pixel-level and image-level forgery detection evaluation.
citation: Dong, J., Wang, W., & Tan, T. (2013). CASIA Image Tampering Detection Evaluation Database. In 2013 IEEE China Summit and International Conference on Signal and Information Processing (ChinaSIP), 422–426.

license.notes: Unverified. The dataset publisher's license terms are not stated on the Kaggle mirror; the inventory describes CASIA research use.
